svg.title: Issue 9 Page 19 SPLASH — Theodore's fairy tale, the temporary hearth
svg.desc: Full-page splash, slightly elevated angle. Wall cavity camp transformed by warm amber gaslight. Theodore at wall gap candlelit. Squad drawn toward warmth in loose constellation. Sable closest in silver. Jink lower beam emerald watching. Wren station copper schematics dimmed. Thresh perimeter crimson head angled to listen. The temporary hearth before the fairy tale.

g.text: "My grandmother — my father's mother — told me once about a fairy queen."
